body:
READING PASS LEDGER (6 Nov 2026, Claude Sonnet 5.5), so that another session or account does not redo it. The findings are rows B-62 to B-92 of docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md; the counts are in that file's paragraph "Full reading pass". Tests were excluded by the owner.

DONE. Documents 54 of 68 in full. Server 63 of 63 in full (package, installer, deploy). App 29 of 231 in full: playback/playback_engine; data/downloads/download_manager; app/{connection,session,app,bootstrap,providers,background_sync,alerts_wiring}; data/sync/{server_identity,endpoint_resolver,sync_scheduler}; data/encore/{encore_sync,encore_delivery,encore_upgrade,encore_instant,encore_api,encore_mutations,encore_writer,encore_live}; features/providers; features/instant/instant_controller; data/db/{tables,app_database,search_dao}; data/repos/{library_repository,downloads_repository}; features/onboarding/connect_screen; features/settings/sign_out. In part (13): data/sync/sync_engine (Encore branch), outbox (42-290), app/playback_providers (1-330) and others. The rest of the app was swept with searches only (TODO, FIXME, workaround, analyzer waivers, swallowed exceptions, personal strings: clean). Packages: 0 of 9. Documents in part: 01, 07, design/00-screen-inventory, history/README, getting-started, tasks P1, P2, P3; skimmed: 02, P4.

NEXT, IN THIS ORDER (risk first). 1 playback/queue_model and encore_audio_handler. 2 features/jam/{jam_facade,jam_providers} and all of packages/encore_session (B-82: the Jam wraps every play). 3 the rest of data/sync (sync_state_store, library_writer, pending_intent, fingerprint). 4 features/import against the server's import contract. 5 features/downloads/download_providers in full. 6 skim the widget folders (features/*).

TO VERIFY, NOT YET IN THE REGISTER. (a) library_repository.watchMyMusic counts play_count and the phone's own play_history only: plays from another device or from before a reinstall may be missing from "My music" on an Encore server (D-27 decides the switch itself). (b) downloads_repository.watchPinState counts tracks flagged missing in total but never in done. (c) keeper.placement is never given total_discs, so the DD-TT file prefix is dead code. (d) `encore` run as a non-root user loses ENCORE_DIR for a non-default --dir (sudo resets the environment). (e) lean.py logs under the name encore_fetch.lean.

RULES LEARNED THE HARD WAY. Verify with the right API before claiming (main is protected by a RULESET: gh api repos/.../rulesets; the classic endpoint answers 404). Check Encore mode against old plain-music-server mode before claiming what runs. Merge only on green CI for the exact head sha (gh pr merge N --squash --match-head-commit SHA). Do not claim "all read" unless the ledger says so. Run a claim when you can (a scratch database for the server; SQLite FTS5 for search).

The ledger file and the scripts live in a session scratchpad and are gone with it; rebuild the list from this note if needed.
